lesson_section: 7.1 Data security key concepts: What is data loss prevention (DLP)?

normal.threat: A restricted invoice could be sent to an unauthorized external recipient.
normal.control: Inspect outbound email for restricted invoice content and warn or block unapproved external sharing.
normal.residual_risk: A renamed or otherwise unrecognized attachment could evade inspection.

boundary.threat: A restricted invoice could be sent to an unauthorized external recipient.
boundary.control: Inspect outbound email and block unapproved sharing.
boundary.residual_risk: Unrecognized attachment formats could evade inspection.

failure.threat: Payroll data could be exposed through an unauthorized external email.
failure.control: Test backup restoration to reduce downtime after data loss.
failure.residual_risk: A successful restore does not prevent payroll data from being emailed to an unauthorized recipient.
